acceptanceCriteria: Repository truth matches the packet and all non-generated paths are clean.
Exact artifact verification passes and matches builder evidence.
The checker reports profile, session/run ID, commit, artifact SHA-256, build ID, evidence paths, and one bounded verdict.
stopConditions: Return FAIL - REPAIRABLE on contract, repository, evidence, or artifact mismatch.
Return BLOCKED - external evidence required only for unavailable external device or authorized environment proof.
Never modify, repair, release, push, publish, deploy, or change a Hermes profile.
nextAction: Run the declared read-only checks and return exactly one bounded checker verdict.
